_notes: Reward categories (docs/SPEC-cards.md §4): how the card network codes the merchant (its MCC), not what was bought.
MCCs are hints only; issuers define their categories in their own terms. Ids feed the __REWARD_CATEGORY_IDS__ schema placeholder.

categories.name: Dining
categories.description: Restaurants, bars, cafes and fast food, as the card network codes them.

categories.name: Food delivery
categories.description: Food delivery apps and services (for example, delivery from restaurants through an app).

categories.name: Supermarkets
categories.description: Merchants coded as grocery stores and supermarkets. Issuers often exclude superstores, warehouse clubs and discount stores.

categories.name: Wholesale clubs
categories.description: Warehouse and wholesale clubs (membership warehouses).

categories.name: Discount stores
categories.description: Discount stores and superstores that are not coded as supermarkets.

categories.name: Department stores
categories.description: Department stores.

categories.name: Drugstores
categories.description: Drugstores and pharmacies.

categories.name: Gas stations
categories.description: Gas stations and automated fuel dispensers.

categories.name: EV charging
categories.description: Electric vehicle charging stations.

categories.name: Airlines
categories.description: Airline tickets and fees bought from the airline.

categories.name: Hotels
categories.description: Hotels, motels and resorts.

categories.name: Car rental
categories.description: Car rental agencies.

categories.name: Travel agencies
categories.description: Travel agencies, online travel sites and tour operators, including issuers' travel portals.

categories.name: Cruises
categories.description: Cruise lines and steamships.

categories.name: Transit
categories.description: Local and commuter transit, trains, ferries and buses.

categories.name: Rideshare and taxi
categories.description: Rideshare services, taxis and limousines.

categories.name: Parking and tolls
categories.description: Parking lots and garages, tolls and bridge fees.

categories.name: Streaming and TV
categories.description: Streaming services and cable or satellite TV.

categories.name: Digital goods
categories.description: Digital goods and media: apps, games, music and e-books.

categories.name: Entertainment
categories.description: Movie theaters, live events, sports and amusement venues.

categories.name: Telecom
categories.description: Phone, wireless and internet providers.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.description: Electric, gas, water and sanitation utilities.

categories.name: Home improvement
categories.description: Home improvement and hardware stores.

categories.name: Electronics
categories.description: Electronics stores.

categories.name: Apparel
categories.description: Clothing, shoe and accessory stores.

categories.name: Fitness
categories.description: Gyms, fitness clubs and athletic clubs.

categories.name: Insurance
categories.description: Insurance premiums.

categories.name: Medical
categories.description: Doctors, dentists, hospitals and other medical services.

categories.name: Education
categories.description: Schools, colleges and tuition.

categories.name: Rent and housing
categories.description: Rent, mortgage and other housing payments.

categories.name: Taxes and government
categories.description: Tax payments, government fees and services.

categories.name: Charity
categories.description: Charitable and nonprofit organizations.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Anything not in another reward category.
